description: Measured liquid refractive indices, for training the learned expert that answers where no density is available to feed Lorentz-Lorenz.
provenance: CRC Handbook organic refractive indices as bundled with the chemicals package, keyed by CAS and resolved to structures with its own identifier database. Restricted to neutral single-fragment organic molecules of at least two atoms, with values between 1.2 and 2.2; entries with several tabulated temperatures are averaged, and the tabulated temperature is mostly 293 K. These are handbook values rather than a curated benchmark. The 385 compounds that also carry a tabulated liquid density are NOT excluded here, because excluding them would cost the shipped model nearly a tenth of its data; the head-to-head against Lorentz-Lorenz reported in docs/BENCHMARKS.md was measured on a forest refitted with all 385 removed, so that comparison is held out even though this file is not.
